drafts.answer: Her most recent movie I could confirm is Bugonia, the Yorgos Lanthimos sci-fi thriller released in October 2025. My searches didn't turn up a reliable 2026 release, so check a current source if you want the very latest.
Andy Burnham is the UK prime minister. He took office in July 2026 after Keir Starmer announced his resignation as prime minister and Labour leader in June.
Spain won the 2026 World Cup, beating Argentina 1-0 in the final on July 19, 2026.
Pluto was discovered in 1930, by Clyde Tombaugh at Lowell Observatory (announced February 18, 1930).
The capital of Australia is Canberra.
Oppenheimer (2023) was directed by Christopher Nolan.
Mount Kilimanjaro is about 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) tall above sea level.
Saturn has the most moons, with 293 confirmed as of August 2026 according to NASA's moons page (its meta description still says 274).
Frankenstein was written by Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley (Mary Shelley).
The platypus was first described by scientists in 1799, when George Shaw published a formal description of it after a specimen reached Britain in 1798.
The Berlin Wall fell in 1989, when East Germany opened its borders on November 9, 1989.
António Guterres is the UN Secretary-General, and his term runs through December 31, 2026, with a successor selection process already underway.
